summary:
Iter 46 FINAL competition bug-fix pass — ALL VERIFIED. Backend 7/7 pytest (pytest_iter46.xml, ~1.2s): (1) POST /api/auth/dev-bypass returns session_token; /api/auth/me shows email=guardian.angel.core@proton.me, language=en. (2) GET /api/geo/context defaults to New York/US, lat 40.7128, lng -74.006. (3) POST /api/geo/set-city with 'Vienna' works and persists; reset to 'New York' works. (4) GET /api/lifecard predictions.items contains 'Annual physical examination' with suggested_date 2026-09-15 (demo prediction preserved). (5) GET /api/calendar/timeline contains all 7 seeded demo records (Flu vaccine, Tetanus booster, COVID-19 booster, Knee arthroscopy, Appendectomy, Lab: Blood glucose, Lab: Total cholesterol). (6) GET /api/healing/state steps_meta EN titles verified: intake→Intake, financial_shield→Financial Shield, access→Access, bureaucracy→Paperwork (backend key is 'bureaucracy'; title 'Paperwork' — correct). No Slovak markers in steps_meta.

STATIC REVIEW: (a) /app/frontend/src/guardian.tsx fall detection is CORRECT — sustained free-fall mag<0.3g starting at freeFallStart, confirmed at ≥80ms (freeFallAt.current=now), followed by impact mag>2.5g within 1200ms, 30s cooldown (now - lastFallNav > 30000). Reset on mag>0.5 outside free-fall window. No syntax issues. Manual SOS independent — Get Help Now button in fall-verify triggers separate flow. (b) /app/frontend/app/jarvis.tsx wake-word effect at L318-326 is native-gated (`Platform.OS === 'web'` early return) — will not crash web. Effect deps [mode, recording, busy] ensure it re-arms in ALL 3 modes. Cleanup properly unsubscribes. (c) /app/frontend/src/voice.ts DEFAULT_VOICE='onyx' at L15; MOOD_VOICE all use onyx as base timbre; speak() falls back silently on web without throwing.

FRONTEND (mobile 390x844 web preview, founder bypass): (1) /login shows founder-bypass-btn on preview host (isDevEnv gating correct — preview URL is NOT hiding the button). Single tap → /(tabs), fully authenticated. (2) Home: EN throughout (Good day, Guardian Angel OS · Your Personal Health Guardian, MAGIC LENS tile, JARVIS orb 'Tap and speak — your angel is listening', HEALING LOOP steps '1. INTAKE / 2. FINANCIAL SHIELD / 3. ACCESS…', DAILY BRIEFING, GUARDIAN LENS, tab bar HEALING / FAMILY SHIELD / VAULT). demo-badge visible top-right. Geo pill shows 'New York · US' (default). (3) /health-timeline: lc-edit opens editor, lc-gdpr-consent checkbox 'I consent to storing my health data' visible; tapping lc-save-card WITHOUT ticking shows red error 'Please tick "I consent to storing my health data" first.'; ticking → save succeeds, error clears, editor closes. Screen fully EN (LIFE CARD, MY CARD, CHILD, MAGIC LENS, PDF FOR DOCTOR, EU VACCINATION PASS, HEALTH TRENDS, PREDICTIONS · JARVIS with 'Annual physical examination' CHECK-UP · 2026-09-15, ADD TO CALENDAR, IDENTITY · SOURCE: BIRTH CERTIFICATE, DATE OF BIRTH / AGE / BLOOD TYPE, SCAN BIRTH CERTIFICATE, FROM GALLERY). (4) /jarvis: loads on web without crash (wake-word Platform.OS='web' early-returns cleanly, no error visible in console). All 3 mode chips (jv-mode-chat, jv-mode-sonar, jv-mode-imagine) present and tappable. (5) EN spot-check clean (no Slovak markers found in body text) on: /fall-verify (FALL DETECTED, UNTIL THE ALARM IS SENT, LISTENING… SPEAK NOW, I'M OK, GET HELP NOW), /voice-echoes, /family-contacts, /onboarding, /insurance, /calendar-sync, /pulse-check. (6) /fall-verify loads and manual buttons render — 'GET HELP NOW' and 'I'M OK' visible.

MINOR SLOVAK LEAK (Jarvis mode chip): /app/frontend/app/jarvis.tsx L486 hardcodes label 'OBRAZ' (Slovak for 'IMAGE') for the imagine mode chip. Other chip labels are English ('CHAT', 'SONAR · WEB'). Recommend changing to 'IMAGE' or 'IMAGINE' — minor polish, functionality unaffected.

AI response also contains a Slovak disclaimer line 'Toto je AI-generovaný informatívny obsah.' — this is LLM-generated content (not hardcoded); appears alongside the correct EN watermark '— AI Content · Sovereign Protocol'. May be prompt-tuning opportunity but not a hardcoded-UI leak.

ui_bugs.issue: Mode chip label hardcoded Slovak 'OBRAZ' at L486 — should be 'IMAGE' or 'IMAGINE' to match English UI. Reference: /app/frontend/app/jarvis.tsx:486

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings persist: 'shadow*' → boxShadow, 'textShadow*' → textShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents. Pre-existing app-wide.
Warning 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' — pre-existing, web only, expected.

action_items: OPTIONAL (LOW): Change /app/frontend/app/jarvis.tsx line 486 label 'OBRAZ' → 'IMAGE' (English UI consistency).

OPTIONAL: The Jarvis LLM chat occasionally appends a Slovak disclaimer 'Toto je AI-generovaný informatívny obsah.' alongside the EN watermark — prompt could enforce disclaimer language matches user.language when language='en'.
critical_code_review_comments: guardian.tsx fall-detection state machine is CORRECT — freeFallStart tracks first <0.3g sample, freeFallAt set when >=80ms sustained; impact requires mag>2.5g within 1200ms of freeFallAt AND >30s cooldown; window resets on mag>0.5 outside free-fall. Manual SOS in fall-verify is independent (separate route push).
jarvis.tsx L318-326: wake-word effect Platform.OS==='web' early return + deps [mode,recording,busy] correctly re-arms wake-word in every mode transition on native and silently no-ops on web.
voice.ts DEFAULT_VOICE='onyx'; all MOOD_VOICE entries pinned to onyx (single timbre with speed modulation) — matches founder spec. speak() try/catches all errors → never throws to caller.
backend/routes/geo.py returns default {city:'New York', country:'US', lat:40.7128, lng:-74.006} — matches spec exactly. set-city persists user.geo_override; get context prefers override.
backend/routes/healing.py STEP_META EN complete: Intake, Financial Shield, Access, Paperwork (key 'bureaucracy'), Recovery. KIND_LABEL EN: Injury/Illness.

backend demo seed retained: predictions.items has 'Annual physical examination' 2026-09-15; calendar/timeline has 7 seeded EN records + prediction event. DO NOT call /api/lifecard/predictions (regenerate) — would wipe seed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (login, home banner+DEMO+geo, /health-timeline GDPR consent gate + save + EN copy, /jarvis loads + 3 mode chips, /fall-verify EN + manual buttons, EN spot-checks on 6 secondary screens)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Founder demo Life Card + calendar timeline preserved. Do NOT regenerate predictions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests: /app/backend/tests/test_iter46_final_bugfix.py (7/7 pass, LoadScope xdist). Founder bypass: POST /api/auth/dev-bypass {email:'guardian.angel.core@proton.me',name:'Guardian Angel'}. Key endpoints verified: /auth/dev-bypass, /auth/me, /geo/context (default NYC), /geo/set-city, /lifecard (predictions.items shape), /calendar/timeline, /healing/state (bureaucracy key = Paperwork title). Frontend testIDs used: founder-bypass-btn, home-welcome-banner, demo-badge, home-magic-lens, lc-edit, lc-gdpr-consent, lc-save-card, jv-mode-chat/sonar/imagine. NOTE: healing key 'bureaucracy' maps to title 'Paperwork' — do not confuse. One minor Slovak leak: jarvis.tsx L486 label 'OBRAZ' (imagine chip).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. One minor English-consistency polish item: /app/frontend/app/jarvis.tsx L486 label 'OBRAZ' hardcoded Slovak — change to 'IMAGE' or 'IMAGINE'.
